########## # Solution ##########
BEGIN_PGML_SOLUTION To remove the [`\frac{3}{7}`] from the left side, we need to _add_ [`\frac{3}{7}`] to each side of the equation.
[``` \begin{aligned} q-\frac{3}{7}\amp=\frac{3}{2}\\ q-\frac{3}{7}\addright{\frac{3}{7}}\amp=\frac{3}{2}\addright{\frac{3}{7}}\\ q\amp=\highlight{\frac{21}{14}}+\highlight{\frac{6}{14}}\\ q\amp=\frac{27}{14} \end{aligned} ```]
We should check the solution by substituting [`\frac{27}{14}`] in for [`q`] in the original equation:
[``` \begin{aligned} q-\frac{3}{7}\amp=\frac{3}{2}\\ \substitute{\frac{27}{14}}-\frac{3}{7}\amp\wonder{=}\frac{3}{2}\\ \frac{27}{14}-\frac{6}{14}\amp\wonder{=}\frac{3}{2}\\ \frac{21}{14}\amp\wonder{=}\frac{3}{2}\\ \frac{3}{2}\amp\confirm{=}\frac{3}{2} \end{aligned} ```]
The solution [`\frac{27}{14}`] is checked, and the solution set is [`\left\{\frac{27}{14}\right\}\text{.}`]
